subject: HEALTH
title: Health 2
description: Health 2 helps children build healthy habits and safe choices: naming and managing feelings, friendship, standing up to bullying and appreciating families; germs, dental care, sleep and sun protection; MyPlate, breakfast, snacks, food labels, farm-to-table and food safety; daily activity and screen balance; body systems and growth; pedestrian, bike, water, fire, earthquake and personal safety; medicine, poison, tobacco and alcohol awareness; and community health helpers and a healthy environment.
framework: 2008 California Health Education Content Standards; 2019 CA Health Education Framework

standards.H-2.1.1.M: Identify a variety of feelings and describe healthy ways to express and cope with them.
standards.H-2.1.2.M: Describe qualities of a good friend and ways to include others.
standards.H-2.1.3.M: Explain how families and family members are different and how they support one another.
standards.H-2.4.1.M: Demonstrate listening skills and 'I-messages' to resolve conflicts and express feelings.
standards.H-2.4.2.M: Demonstrate how to respond to bullying, including telling a trusted adult and helping others.
standards.H-2.7.1.M: Practice strategies to manage stress and strong emotions (deep breathing, counting, asking for help).
standards.H-2.1.1.P: Explain how germs cause illness and how handwashing, covering coughs, and vaccines help prevent disease.
standards.H-2.1.2.P: Describe proper dental care, including brushing, flossing, limiting sugary foods, and the role of dentists.
standards.H-2.1.3.P: Explain why adequate sleep, rest, and limited screen time are important for health.
standards.H-2.1.4.P: Describe ways to protect skin, eyes, and ears (sun protection, eye safety, loud noise).
standards.H-2.3.1.P: Identify trusted adults and health professionals in the community who promote health.
standards.H-2.6.1.P: Set a personal health goal (e.g., brushing twice daily) and track progress.
standards.H-2.7.1.P: Demonstrate personal hygiene and dental-care practices.
standards.H-2.8.1.P: Encourage others to reduce, reuse, and recycle and to keep the environment healthy.
standards.H-2.1.1.N: Identify the five food groups on MyPlate and recommended daily amounts for children.
standards.H-2.1.2.N: Describe the benefits of eating a variety of fruits and vegetables and drinking water.
standards.H-2.1.3.N: Explain the importance of eating breakfast and choosing healthy snacks low in added sugar, fat, and salt.
standards.H-2.1.4.N: Identify where food comes from and how it gets from farms to the table.
standards.H-2.1.5.N: Explain how physical activity and limiting screen time benefit the body and mind.
standards.H-2.2.1.N: Explain how media and advertising influence food choices.
standards.H-2.3.1.N: Use simple information on food labels (serving size, sugar) to compare foods.
standards.H-2.5.1.N: Use a decision-making process to choose healthy meals and snacks.
standards.H-2.6.1.N: Set a goal to increase daily physical activity or healthy food choices and monitor progress.
standards.H-2.7.1.N: Practice food safety: handwashing, washing produce, and keeping foods at safe temperatures.
standards.H-2.1.1.G: Describe the basic structure and functions of the skeletal, muscular, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory systems.
standards.H-2.1.2.G: Explain that people grow and develop at different rates and that each person is unique.
standards.H-2.1.3.G: Describe how the senses work and how to protect sense organs.
standards.H-2.1.4.G: Identify life stages (infant, child, teen, adult, older adult) and how needs change.
standards.H-2.1.1.S: Identify safety rules for walking, biking, riding in vehicles, and using playgrounds.
standards.H-2.1.2.S: Describe fire, earthquake, and emergency safety, including a family emergency plan and kit.
standards.H-2.1.3.S: Explain water and sun safety rules.
standards.H-2.1.4.S: Distinguish between safe and unsafe touch and situations, including online and with strangers.
standards.H-2.1.5.S: Identify dangers of weapons and what to do if a weapon is found.
standards.H-2.4.1.S: Demonstrate how to call 911, give accurate information, and ask a trusted adult for help.
standards.H-2.7.1.S: Practice safety behaviors such as wearing a helmet, using a seat belt or booster seat, and following drills.
standards.H-2.1.1.A: Explain the difference between medicines and other drugs and the rules for using medicines safely.
standards.H-2.1.2.A: Identify household products that are poisonous and how to read warning labels.
standards.H-2.1.3.A: Describe the harmful effects of tobacco, vaping, secondhand smoke, and alcohol on the body.
standards.H-2.2.1.A: Identify how family, friends, and media influence decisions about alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs.
standards.H-2.4.1.A: Demonstrate refusal skills to avoid unsafe substances and situations.

units.title: Feelings, Friends and Families
units.big_idea: Understanding feelings and treating others with kindness help everyone feel safe and included.

units.title: Personal Health and Hygiene
units.big_idea: Daily habits like washing hands, caring for teeth and sleeping well protect our health.

units.title: Nutrition: Fuel for Growing Bodies
units.big_idea: A variety of foods from every food group, plus water, fuels our bodies and brains.

units.title: Active Living
units.big_idea: Daily movement and less screen time help our bodies and minds.

units.title: How My Body Works and Grows
units.big_idea: Body systems work together, and everyone grows in their own way.

units.title: Injury Prevention and Safety
units.big_idea: Knowing safety rules and having a plan help us prevent injuries and act in emergencies.

units.title: Medicines, Poisons, Tobacco and Alcohol
units.big_idea: Some substances help and some harm; we make safe choices and ask trusted adults.

units.title: Healthy Communities
units.big_idea: Health helpers and caring citizens keep our community and environment healthy.

weeks.topic: Feelings and how we show them
objectives: Name a wide range of feelings
Describe healthy ways to express feelings
materials: 'In My Heart: A Book of Feelings' by Jo Witek (library)

days.title: Feelings book
days.work: Read 'In My Heart' by Jo Witek and list every feeling word in the book.

days.title: Feelings thermometer
days.work: Make a feelings thermometer from calm to very upset and color where you are today.

days.title: Same situation, different feelings
days.work: Discuss how two people might feel differently about the same event (a thunderstorm, a new baby).

days.title: Healthy vs. unhealthy
days.work: Sort cards of ways to show anger (yelling, hitting, talking, drawing, walking away) into healthy and unhealthy.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write 3 sentences: 'I feel ___ when ___. I can ___.'

objectives: Use strategies to manage strong feelings

days.title: Breathing tools
days.work: Practice balloon breathing, five-finger breathing and counting to 10.

days.title: Calm-down jar
days.work: Make a glitter calm-down jar and watch the glitter settle while breathing slowly.

days.title: Calm corner
days.work: Set up a calm corner at home with a pillow, book and feelings chart.

days.title: Mindful movement
days.work: Do a GoNoodle Flow or kids yoga video and notice how your body feels after.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Role-play a frustrating moment (losing a game) and use one calming strategy.

weeks.assessment: Role-play demonstration of a calming strategy.

objectives: Describe qualities of a good friend

days.title: Read aloud
days.work: Read 'The Invisible Boy' by Trudy Ludwig and discuss how Brian felt left out.

days.title: Friend recipe
days.work: Write a 'Recipe for a Good Friend' listing ingredients like kindness, sharing and listening.

days.title: Listening skills
days.work: Practice active listening: eyes on speaker, nod, ask a question; take turns telling about your weekend.

days.title: I-messages
days.work: Learn 'I feel ___ when ___ because ___' and use it in 3 friend-problem role-plays.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Name 3 qualities of a good friend and show one I-message.

materials: 'Stand Tall, Molly Lou Melon' by Patty Lovell (library)

days.title: Read aloud
days.work: Read 'Stand Tall, Molly Lou Melon' and talk about how Molly handled being teased.

days.title: What is bullying
days.work: Learn the difference between rude, mean and bullying (repeated, on purpose, hurtful).

days.title: Upstander moves
days.work: Practice 3 upstander moves: say 'Stop', walk away with the target, tell a trusted adult.

days.title: Trusted adults
days.work: Draw a hand and write a trusted adult on each finger.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Respond correctly to 3 bullying scenarios and explain the difference between telling and tattling.

objectives: Describe how families differ and support each other

days.title: Read aloud
days.work: Read 'The Family Book' by Todd Parr and list ways families are alike and different.

days.title: Family portrait
days.work: Draw your family and label how each person helps the family.

days.title: Family jobs
days.work: Make a chore chart and choose two jobs you will do this week.

days.title: Family meeting
days.work: Hold a short family meeting to share feelings and plan a fun activity together.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Tell 3 ways your family supports you and 2 ways you support your family.

days.title: Glitter germs
days.work: Put lotion and glitter on hands, shake hands with family and see how 'germs' spread.

days.title: Handwashing steps
days.work: Learn the 5 handwashing steps (wet, lather, scrub 20 seconds, rinse, dry) and sing 'Happy Birthday' twice.

days.title: Pepper experiment
days.work: Sprinkle pepper on water and touch it with a soapy finger to see soap push 'germs' away.

days.title: Cover coughs
days.work: Practice coughing and sneezing into an elbow and learn how vaccines help protect us.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Demonstrate handwashing correctly and list 3 times you should wash hands.

days.title: Tooth parts
days.work: Learn tooth parts (enamel, gum) and how plaque causes cavities; count your teeth in a mirror.

days.title: Egg experiment
days.work: Soak hard-boiled eggs in water, soda and vinegar overnight to model how drinks affect enamel.

days.title: Check the eggs
days.work: Observe and record the eggs; discuss why limiting sugary drinks helps teeth.

days.title: Brush & floss
days.work: Practice 2-minute brushing in circles and flossing with a parent; start a brushing chart.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain the egg experiment results and demonstrate proper brushing.

days.title: Why sleep
days.work: Learn that kids need 9–12 hours of sleep and how sleep helps the brain and growth.

days.title: Sleep log
days.work: Start a 4-night sleep log noting bedtime and wake time.

days.title: Bedtime routine
days.work: Draw a picture schedule for a calm bedtime routine (bath, teeth, book, lights out).

days.title: Screen limits
days.work: Discuss how screens before bed affect sleep; make a family 'screens off' time.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Total your sleep hours from the log and set a bedtime goal.

days.title: Sun print
days.work: Leave construction paper with objects on it in the sun to see how UV rays fade it; discuss skin.

days.title: Sun safety
days.work: Learn 'Slip, Slop, Slap, Wrap' (shirt, sunscreen, hat, sunglasses) and read an SPF label.

days.title: Eye safety
days.work: Discuss safety goggles, never looking at the sun and screen breaks (20-20-20 rule).

days.title: Ear safety
days.work: Compare quiet and loud sounds, and learn why loud music and noise can hurt hearing.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make a poster about protecting skin, eyes and ears.

objectives: Set and track a personal hygiene goal

days.title: Habit check
days.work: Review habits from this unit and rate yourself on each with a smiley scale.

days.title: Pick a goal
days.work: Choose one habit to improve (brush twice daily, wash hands before meals) and write it as a goal.

days.title: Make a tracker
days.work: Make a 2-week sticker tracker for your goal.

days.title: Hygiene kit
days.work: Pack a personal hygiene kit (toothbrush, tissues, travel soap) and explain each item.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Quiz: germs, teeth, sleep and sun protection (10 oral questions); begin tracking your goal.

objectives: Classify foods into the five food groups

days.title: MyPlate
days.work: Learn the 5 food groups using MyPlate and name 3 foods in each.

days.title: Flyer sort
days.work: Cut foods from grocery flyers and glue them onto a MyPlate poster.

days.title: Plate check
days.work: Draw your dinner and check which food groups it had and which were missing.

days.title: Food group game
days.work: Play 'food group freeze': run to the corner for the food group called.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Sort 15 food cards into groups and plan one balanced lunch.

weeks.assessment: Food sort and balanced lunch plan.

objectives: Explain benefits of fruits, vegetables and water

days.title: Eat the rainbow
days.work: Make a color chart of fruits and vegetables and taste one new produce item.

days.title: Plant parts we eat
days.work: Sort vegetables by plant part (root, stem, leaf, seed, fruit), connecting to the Science plant unit.

days.title: Water for life
days.work: Learn why the body needs water; track water cups drunk today.

days.title: Rethink your drink
days.work: Compare sugar in juice, soda and milk by measuring teaspoons of sugar into cups.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write 3 reasons to eat fruits and vegetables and drink water.

objectives: Choose snacks low in added sugar, fat and salt

days.title: Breakfast power
days.work: Learn how breakfast fuels the brain; plan 3 balanced breakfasts.

days.title: Snack sort
days.work: Sort snacks into 'go' (every day), 'slow' (sometimes) and 'whoa' (once in a while).

days.title: Decision steps
days.work: Use a 3-step decision process (choices, think about results, choose) to pick an after-school snack.

days.title: Snack lab
days.work: Make a healthy snack like apple 'nachos' or veggie wraps and wash produce first.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain your snack choice using the decision steps.

days.title: Label hunt
days.work: Find the serving size and sugar on 3 cereal boxes.

days.title: Compare cereals
days.work: Rank the cereals from least to most sugar per serving.

days.title: Ad detectives
days.work: Watch or look at food ads and identify tricks (cartoon characters, toys, bright colors).

days.title: Design an ad
days.work: Design a cereal box or ad for a healthy food using honest claims.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain how ads try to influence kids and how labels help you choose.

objectives: Describe how food gets from farms to our plates
materials: 'From Seed to Plant' by Gail Gibbons (library)

days.title: Where food comes from
days.work: Trace a food (e.g., strawberries, milk) from a California farm to the table; draw the steps.

days.title: Farmers market
days.work: Visit a farmers market or grocery produce section and list 5 local foods.

days.title: Seasonal foods
days.work: Learn which fruits and vegetables grow in each season in California.

days.title: Grow a snack
days.work: Plant a quick herb or sprout lettuce seeds in a cup.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain the farm-to-table path for one food.

days.title: Clean, separate, cook, chill
days.work: Learn the 4 food safety steps and find examples in your kitchen.

days.title: Fridge check
days.work: Check fridge temperature with a parent and see where foods are stored.

days.title: Plan a meal
days.work: Plan a balanced family dinner using MyPlate.

days.title: Cook together
days.work: Help cook the planned meal, washing hands and produce first.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Unit quiz on food groups, snacks, labels and food safety.

objectives: Explain how activity helps body and mind

days.title: 60 minutes
days.work: Learn kids need 60 minutes of activity daily; brainstorm active things to do.

days.title: Mood and movement
days.work: Rate your mood before and after a 10-minute walk.

days.title: Activity log
days.work: Start a week-long activity log of minutes moved.

days.title: Family challenge
days.work: Plan a family active challenge (dance party, bike ride, hike).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Total your active minutes and set a goal for next week.

objectives: Balance screen time and active time

days.title: Screen count
days.work: Track screen time for 2 days and compare with active minutes.

days.title: Swap list
days.work: Make a list of 10 active swaps for screen time.

days.title: Screen-free day
days.work: Plan and enjoy a screen-free afternoon outdoors.

days.title: Goal check
days.work: Check progress on last week's activity goal and update the log.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain how balancing screens and movement helps your health.

objectives: Describe the skeletal and muscular systems

days.title: Skeleton
days.work: Learn major bones (skull, ribs, spine) and their jobs; feel them on your body.

days.title: Paper skeleton
days.work: Build a paper skeleton with brad joints and label 6 bones.

days.title: Muscles pull
days.work: Feel the biceps and triceps when bending and straightening your arm.

days.title: Strong bones
days.work: Learn how calcium and exercise build strong bones.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Label bones and explain how muscles and bones work together.

objectives: Describe the circulatory and respiratory systems

days.title: Heart pump
days.work: Squeeze a tennis ball to feel how hard the heart works; learn it pumps blood.

days.title: Lung model
days.work: Build a balloon lung model in a plastic bottle.

days.title: Breathing count
days.work: Count breaths per minute at rest and after jumping.

days.title: Healthy heart
days.work: List ways to keep heart and lungs healthy (exercise, no smoking).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain how heart and lungs work together to move oxygen.

objectives: Describe the path of food through the body

days.title: Food journey
days.work: Learn the path: mouth, esophagus, stomach, intestines.

days.title: Stomach model
days.work: Mash crackers and water in a zip bag to model the stomach.

days.title: Intestine model
days.work: Squeeze mush through a stocking to model the intestines.

days.title: Fiber & water
days.work: Discuss why fiber and water help digestion.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Draw and label the digestive system.

objectives: Describe how senses work and how to protect them

days.title: Senses stations
days.work: Do touch, smell and taste mystery stations with a blindfold.

days.title: Brain messages
days.work: Learn that sense organs send messages to the brain.

days.title: Eyes & ears check
days.work: Do a simple eye chart and whisper test; learn about vision and hearing checkups.

days.title: Protect senses
days.work: Make a list of ways to protect each sense organ.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Match each sense to its organ and one protection tip.

objectives: Explain that people grow at different rates

days.title: Then and now
days.work: Compare a baby photo to now; list what you can do now.

days.title: Measure me
days.work: Measure height, hand span and foot; compare with family members.

days.title: Life stages
days.work: Make a life-stage timeline (infant to older adult) and note needs at each.

days.title: Everyone is unique
days.work: Discuss how kids grow at different rates and that differences are normal.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Present your timeline and one way you have grown.

objectives: Follow safety rules walking, biking and riding

days.title: Street smart
days.work: Practice stop, look left-right-left, and listen at a crosswalk with a parent.

days.title: Helmet fit
days.work: Check helmet fit with the 2-V-1 rule.

days.title: Bike skills
days.work: Practice hand signals and stopping on a chalk course.

days.title: Car safety
days.work: Learn why kids ride in booster seats in the back seat with seat belts.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Demonstrate crosswalk safety and helmet fit.

objectives: Follow playground, water and sun safety rules

days.title: Playground rules
days.work: Visit a playground and identify safe and unsafe behaviors.

days.title: Water safety
days.work: Learn rules: swim with an adult, wear a life jacket, never swim alone.

days.title: Reach or throw
days.work: Practice 'reach or throw, don't go' to help someone in water.

days.title: Sun & heat
days.work: Review sun safety and signs of overheating.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Sort scenario cards into safe and unsafe.

objectives: Know fire safety rules and a home escape plan

days.title: Fire facts
days.work: Learn about smoke alarms and test one with a parent.

days.title: Stop, drop, roll
days.work: Practice stop, drop and roll and crawling low under smoke.

days.title: Escape map
days.work: Draw a home escape map with two ways out of each room.

days.title: Fire drill
days.work: Hold a family fire drill to the outside meeting place.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain your escape plan and fire rules.

days.title: Drop, cover, hold on
days.work: Learn and practice the earthquake drill in several rooms.

days.title: Emergency kit
days.work: Help build a family emergency kit.

days.title: Calling 911
days.work: Role-play a 911 call stating name, address and the emergency.

days.title: Know your info
days.work: Memorize your address and a parent's phone number.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Do a surprise earthquake drill and recite your address and phone number.

weeks.topic: Safe and unsafe touch and strangers

days.title: Safe vs unsafe
days.work: Discuss safe touches (hugs from family) and unsafe ones, and that your body belongs to you.

days.title: No-Go-Tell
days.work: Practice saying No, getting away and telling a trusted adult.

days.title: Strangers & tricky people
days.work: Learn about tricky people and never going anywhere without permission.

days.title: Secrets vs surprises
days.work: Distinguish surprises (fun, temporary) from unsafe secrets.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Respond to 4 scenarios with No-Go-Tell.

objectives: Know what to do if a weapon is found

days.title: Personal info
days.work: Learn which information stays private online (name, address, school, photos).

days.title: Online rules
days.work: Make family online rules: ask first, tell an adult about anything uncomfortable.

days.title: Weapon safety
days.work: Learn: if you see a gun, don't touch it, leave the area, tell an adult.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Role-play scenarios about online messages and finding a weapon.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Unit quiz on safety rules from weeks 24–29.

days.title: Medicine vs drug
days.work: Learn medicines help when used correctly and that drugs can harm.

days.title: Label reading
days.work: Look at an empty medicine box label with a parent; find the dose and warnings.

days.title: Only from trusted adults
days.work: Discuss why only trusted adults give medicine.

days.title: Candy or medicine?
days.work: Compare look-alike candies and pills and discuss why to never guess.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain 3 rules for medicine safety.

objectives: Identify poisonous products and warning labels

days.title: Label hunt
days.work: Find warning labels and the poison symbol on household products with a parent.

days.title: Safe storage
days.work: Help check that cleaners are stored up high or locked.

days.title: Poison Control
days.work: Learn the Poison Control number (1-800-222-1222) and add it to the phone.

days.title: Saying no
days.work: Practice saying no to tasting unknown substances.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Identify 5 dangerous products and explain what to do if someone swallows one.

days.title: Harmful effects
days.work: Learn how tobacco and vaping harm lungs, heart and teeth.

days.title: Lung model
days.work: Model clean and smoker lungs with sponges and discuss secondhand smoke.

days.title: Influences
days.work: Discuss how friends, family and ads influence choices.

days.title: Refusal skills
days.work: Practice saying no, giving a reason and walking away.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make a 'Smoke-Free Me' poster and role-play a refusal.

days.title: Health helpers
days.work: Learn about doctors, nurses, dentists, pharmacists and school nurses.

days.title: Interview
days.work: Interview a health helper or family member about their job.

days.title: Checkups
days.work: Learn what happens at a checkup and why vaccines matter.

days.title: Thank-you card
days.work: Write a thank-you card to a health helper.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Match 6 helpers to their jobs.

days.title: Three Rs
days.work: Sort household items into reduce, reuse, recycle and trash.

days.title: Clean air & water
days.work: Discuss how pollution affects health.

days.title: Neighborhood cleanup
days.work: Do a park or street cleanup with gloves and an adult.

days.title: Reuse craft
days.work: Make something useful from recyclables.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain how a clean environment helps people stay healthy.

objectives: Encourage others to make healthy choices

days.title: Choose a message
days.work: Choose a health topic from this year to teach others.

days.title: Plan
days.work: Plan a poster or short video message.

days.title: Create
days.work: Create the poster or video.

days.title: Share
days.work: Share your message with family or neighbors.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain why your message matters.

objectives: Reflect on health goals and plan for summer

days.title: Look back
days.work: Review your health portfolio from the year.

days.title: Goal review
days.work: Check progress on hygiene and activity goals.

days.title: Summer plan
days.work: Write a summer health plan with food, activity, sleep and safety goals.

days.title: Health fair
days.work: Hold a family health fair showcasing projects.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Year-end oral review of key health ideas.
